The semantic layer has no GMV metric, so I cannot give a September 2026 figure that counts cancelled orders. The closest metrics are Orders (all orders placed, cancelled included, a count) and Revenue (EUR), which leaves out cancelled orders.

The semantic layer has no repeat purchase rate. The closest metrics are Repeat customers and Active customers (both counts), while Repeat-customer revenue share is a share of revenue, not of customers.
The semantic layer has no cart abandonment rate. The closest metrics are Cart-to-checkout rate and View-to-cart rate, the share of site sessions that take each next step.
The semantic layer has no refund rate by value. The closest metrics are Return rate (returns over orders, by count) and Returns (EUR), a sum of return amounts with no rate attached.
